item.title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
item.description:
Large language model inference uses a lot of memory for the KV cache. MultiAlloc solves this by budgeting how many bits to give each part of the cache under a fixed memory limit, keeping accuracy high. The result is a more efficient cache that uses the same space but delivers better performance.

IT Breakdown: If you manage KV cache for LLMs, use MultiAlloc by: 1) set a total memory budget for the cache; 2) run the MultiAlloc algorithm to decide bit‑precision for each token/layer; 3) apply those precisions during inference to keep accuracy while staying within budget.

item.title: Can Agents Truly Forget? Explore Machine Unlearning for LLM Agents
item.description:
This research tackles the problem of LLM agents leaking sensitive data that they picked up during training. The authors built a machine‑unlearning technique that removes specific unwanted knowledge from an already‑trained agent without retraining from scratch, and showed it keeps the agent’s overall performance intact. If you do not deploy LLM agents, this work is not directly relevant to your day‑to‑day IT infrastructure duties.

IT Breakdown: If your organisation uses LLM agents, check whether those agents were trained on private data; if so, apply the authors’ parameter‑level unlearning method to scrub the model before deployment, then re‑evaluate its performance on core tasks.

item.title: [News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has unveiled new data‑centric AI innovations that enable organizations to leverage the unique intelligence embedded in their own data assets. These updates aim to deepen AI insights by integrating business context directly into Azure and Microsoft 365 services.

item.title: [News] The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
item.description: OpenAI reports that agentic AI is increasingly adopted by EU enterprises and small businesses, with analysis pointing to areas where deeper use could unlock significant value.

item.title: [News] Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
item.description: Google DeepMind and Singapore GovTech have developed a lightweight, on-device Gemma AI model that can detect conversational scams in private chats without sending data to the cloud. The solution intercepts malicious messages in real time, leveraging zero cloud egress to preserve user privacy.

item.title: [News] Scimplify raises $25M to challenge China’s grip on critical materials with AI
item.description: Scimplify, an AI-powered platform focused on critical materials, has secured $25 million in funding to expand into the U.S. market. The company aims to use AI to streamline supply chain decisions and reduce dependency on China.

item.title: [News] Why Every High-Performing Leader Needs a Pacer
item.description: The article discusses elite runner Jakob Ingebrigtsen and the benefit of having a pacing partner to achieve high performance. It focuses on sports training and personal achievement rather than technology.
